marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution, humans curate and set the bar.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人来筛选并设定标准。

marvinschwaibold.en: Human judgment stays essential because AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 人的判断仍不可替代，因为 AI 抬高了上限，却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively; prototypes persuade better than PRD docs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代喂给 AI 智能体；原型比需求文档更有说服力。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; ideas, not execution speed, are now the limit.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建和测试，而不只在 Figma 里画；如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

jeetupatel.en: AI will create more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is the defining constraint.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，供给受限的 AI 基础设施才是核心约束。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys the instinct that makes engineers valuable.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 加速学习，而非外包学习；跳过练习会摧毁让工程师有价值的直觉。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security and silicon, not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: Cisco 的角色是卖铲子：AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而非追逐模型前沿。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you cannot fight a megatrend, so ride it as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，就把它当作顺风。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks scale at machine speed.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 安全与防护决定企业采用；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器速度规模化。

erikbernhardsson.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer and agent experience share foundations.
erikbernhardsson.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 工作负载从零重建，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包装；开发者体验与智能体体验共享基础。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity and avoids knife-fighting.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25+ 云的需求可平滑容量并避免抢购。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform and proprietary infra alpha (file system, container runtime, scheduler), not just cheap token serving.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自多产品平台和专有基础设施 alpha（文件系统、容器运行时、调度器），而不仅是廉价 token 服务。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好；对许多用例而言，微调不再必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power in software because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain leverage like ten interns.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体因在旧代码上训练而赋予软件现有厂商持久优势；资深工程师获得相当于十个实习生的杠杆。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人的品味、差异与真实观点更有价值，而初级人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation risks eroding the expertise needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托任务会侵蚀判断产出所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier persist; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs, so organizations must redesign workflows to augment, not just automate.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿持续存在；更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作，组织必须重构工作流以增强而非仅自动化。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste and agency remain persistent human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非答案机器；广博知识、深厚专长、品味与能动性仍是持久的人类优势。

ethanmollick.en: The internal-public frontier gap is widening, ending iterative deployment; prompting tricks like chain of thought and personas no longer help, and markets underprice AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 内部与公开前沿模型的差距在扩大，迭代部署时代结束；思维链与人设等提示技巧不再奏效，市场低估了 AI。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business, with Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; CapEx raised to $195-205B on supply constraints and strong demand.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；因供给受限与需求强劲，资本开支上调至 1950-2050 亿美元。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Standard models are insufficient; frontier models enable recursive self-improvement, though today's loop still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，标准模型不够用；前沿模型支撑递归自我改进，但今天的循环仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust and safety differentiate consumer agents.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任与安全是消费级智能体的差异化优势。

sundarpichai.en: World models matter alongside LLMs for AGI; interfaces will adapt to humans but persist for consumption and entertainment.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上，世界模型与 LLM 并重；界面会适应人类，但为消费与娱乐仍将存在。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; AI Overviews lower near-term monetization but capture future growth.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；AI 概览压低近期变现，却为未来增长蓄力。

sundarpichai.en: Selling TPU systems to third parties, even competitors, strengthens the platform; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity from model gains.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，向第三方甚至竞争对手出售 TPU 系统会强化平台；2027 年或因模型进步迎来生产力黄金时代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, though why they work remains unclear; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但为何如此顺畅仍不清楚；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability and post-training rise in importance; safety needs frontier models, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：安全研究必须依托前沿模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点，并开始用负责任扩展政策设阈值。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the biggest risk shifts toward overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他判断能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割；风险叙事从“该不该减速”转向“过热才是最大风险”，主张智能护栏而非急刹。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; a 'country of geniuses' arrives in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变框架，改称“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来的平滑指数；并反复警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: From scaling to governance: interpretability, third-party audits and chip controls, with a 10-25% civilizational risk he still works to lower.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年末，主线从 Scaling 延伸到治理：可解释性、第三方审计与芯片管制并重，并公开给出 10-25% 的文明级风险估计，同时坚持放缓而非停止。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 在多数任务上已超过普通人；瓶颈已从模型智能转移到网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use is universal because agents operate any human-designed software, unlike API-based integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 具有通用性：智能体能操作任何人类设计的软件，这与基于 API 的集成不同。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试和重试，完成整个开发周期，而不只是启动任务然后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials to trust agents with real money.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节，才能放心让智能体处理真实资金。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise simultaneously; proactivity reduces adoption friction.
ariweinstein.zh: 我们正处在 computer use 在消费端与企业端同时 Scaling（规模扩张）的时刻；主动性降低了采用摩擦。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand must be tested by whether they try to buy now.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的人的特质，而非公司；需求必须通过对方是否立即购买来检验。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; go to the gemba to observe.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；去现场观察。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将溢价而非折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人途中的脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration, though it may pose security risks.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中至关重要，尽管可能带来安全风险。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever gap between early adopters and everyone else; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与其他人之间制造了史上最大差距；个人比机构采用更快，因此创业公司将激增。

andreessen.en: The brand is now the person: new media rewards authenticity and offense, while corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 品牌即个人：新媒体奖励真实与进攻，而企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才说得通。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，其预测人类行为的准确率约达人们自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans, not super-rational frontier models; post-training with RCT behavioral data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏误、非理性的人，而非超级理性的前沿模型；用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，可弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: counterfactual reasoning and second-order impacts, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：反事实推理与二阶影响，且合成样本组将在三年内超越人类样本组。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, treating simulation as a tool for human decisions with a market far larger than research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题，把模拟视为人类决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能让大规模掌握式学习成为可能。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats RL hype.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；从小的项目起步，监督学习比被炒作的强化学习更实在。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下就能兑现真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks, not jobs, and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，会用 AI 的人取代不用的人。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models counter gatekeepers and fearmongering; coding stays valuable, and bottlenecks are energy and change management.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型对抗守门人与恐惧叙事；编程依然有价值，真正的瓶颈是能源与变革管理。

altman.en: Early focus: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to important problems; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期关注个人效率与选择：减少无关认知负担，低成本广泛探索后果断聚焦重要问题；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; iterative public deployment links alignment to capability, while compute becomes the scarcest input.
altman.zh: 2023 年强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据让模型可用；到 2024 年把迭代式公开部署视为对齐与能力同步提升的路径，并判断算力将是最稀缺资源。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual not leap-like progress; safety must be built through deployment, and agentic AI becomes the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 年强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来的是渐进而非跳跃式进步；2025 年进一步主张安全须通过部署迭代构建，并指出智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and an underdefined term; focus shifts to a continuous ramp toward superintelligence, with compute and energy as bottlenecks.
altman.zh: 2025 年起把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变且定义模糊，2026 年更明确转向通往超级智能的连续爬坡，并把算力与能源视为核心瓶颈。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved and may get harder; he now accepts pausing frontier training and warns against both doomerism and unchecked power concentration.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年立场深化：承认对齐尚未解决且可能更难，愿为安全暂停前沿模型训练，同时警惕盲目末日论与权力过度集中。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law via extreme co-design; scaling works because deep nets absorb more data and compute.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：以极端协同设计延续"超摩尔定律"；深度神经网络能随数据与算力扩张，Scaling（规模扩张）本身即最大突破。

jensen.en: Adds post-training and inference-time thinking as new scaling laws; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把后训练与推理时思考列为新缩放定律；思维链让推理算力需求暴增，通用计算时代结束。

jensen.en: Shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI; each stage needs ~100x compute, tokens become the unit of value.
jensen.zh: 从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每步约需百倍算力；token 成本取代工厂成本成为核心指标。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws, all compute-bound; data no longer bottleneck, synthetic data and open models dominate.
jensen.zh: 2026 年提出四条缩放定律且都受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据与开源模型成为主力。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone insufficient, containment and monitoring; doomer warnings called unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全立场趋硬：仅靠对齐不够，需遏制与监控；称末日警告不科学，主张加速而非放缓。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须建立自己的爬坡机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；应把强大模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建控制层。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; models are commodities, while form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；模型是商品，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要。

satya.en: Being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy; multiple models will coexist, not one model to rule them all.
satya.zh: 落后前沿六个月是明智策略；未来是多个模型共存，而非一个模型统治一切。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, not benchmarks; superintelligence is a better term than AGI, which demeans human agency.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升而非基准分数来衡量；超级智能比 AGI 更准确，后者贬低了人的能动性。

elon.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core; multiplanetary life is existential insurance, and production is harder than prototyping.
elon.zh: 2021 年他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是工程突破的核心，多行星化是文明的生存保险，并指出量产远比原型困难。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; real-world AI beats LLMs on compute efficiency; Neuralink targets bandwidth and human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向求真与监管，认为真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，Neuralink 则瞄准带宽与人机共生。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但八成到九成结果是好的。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and space solar become the path, with Optimus enabling recursive manufacturing and abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年上半年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为出路，Optimus 则带来递归制造与丰裕。

elon.en: AI inference moves to space; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity; peer review replaces slow regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年下半年，他主张 AI 推理上太空，人类将无法控制超级智能，只能植入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代迟缓监管。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他认为设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把品味、手艺与观点视为人类专属；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and prompting will evolve.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：AI 降低下限，人类抬高上限；人们常把模型进步误当产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent line: human judgment and taste stay central, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：人类判断与品味始终居中，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

harrisonchase.en: Agents are harness plus model plus context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and failures come more from poor context than weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算自持智能，而失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work needs custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适配分布内任务；分布外任务需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，如今已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and enable memory and context portability; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、实现记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的路由应放在 harness 内，而非网关层。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; accuracy remains the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点在可靠性而非能力；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，而推理需求被严重低估。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; engineers should encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture rather than rely on code review.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；工程师应把约束写进 CI、lint 和架构，而不是依赖代码评审。

laurentan.en: The engineer's role shifts to manager and environment-builder: skills, constraints, and type systems let agents climb a trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的角色转向管理者和环境构建者：技能、约束与类型系统让智能体沿信任阶梯攀升。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic parts into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; connect outer loops so agents fetch their own context.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性部分抽成脚本和 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体；打通外部循环，让智能体自行获取上下文。

laurentan.en: When failures recur, fix the environment rather than individual agents; sample PRs and mine past transcripts into reusable skills.
laurentan.zh: 失败反复出现时，修环境而非修单个智能体；抽样 PR，并把过往对话记录提炼成可复用技能。

laurentan.en: Strong verification makes auto-merging safe, even while you sleep; review after landing, and let non-engineers contribute code.
laurentan.zh: 强验证让自动合并变得安全，甚至可在你睡觉时进行；落地后再评审，并让非工程师也能贡献代码。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI value hinges on context, not models; 80-90% of knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats frontier dependence.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 的价值取决于上下文而非模型；80-90% 的知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎胜过对前沿模型的依赖。

arvindjain.en: Open source now handles over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今能处理 90% 以上的企业任务；驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是吞吐量与部门指标的问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not competitors; Glean absorbs provider risk and stays replaceable, avoiding lock-in as a headless context layer.
arvindjain.zh: 模型供应商是资产而非竞争对手；Glean 吸收供应商风险并保持可替换，作为无头上下文层避免锁定。

arvindjain.en: We are early in the AI revolution; startups face execution and trust, not competition, and AI should augment work at near-zero marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期；初创公司面对的是执行与信任而非竞争，AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强工作。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, scaling agentic data across economic domains with humans building verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的新前沿，将智能体式数据扩展到各经济领域，人类负责构建验证器和评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法；瓶颈在于为一切构建评估。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents; most work is building evaluations, not trading data.
brendanfoody.zh: 为训练 AI 创造数据将是人类的最后一份工作，人类转向训练智能体；大部分工作是构建评估，而非交易数据。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't reliably grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so eval data must be human.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己的作业打分；在不可验证领域递归自我改进有限，因此评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration; next shift is ultra-long-horizon tasks and virtual co-workers.
brendanfoody.zh: 由于容错率低和迭代缓慢，超级智能进入物理世界将需要数十年；下一次转变是超长周期任务和虚拟同事。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into AI agents; RL with self-generated and synthetic data pushes past the human-data wall.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 继承的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划能力延续到智能体；强化学习借助自生成与合成数据突破人类数据墙。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI thanks to controlled environments.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；受控环境使数字 AGI（通用人工智能）远早于具身 AGI 到来。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; adoption will take 10-20 years, like electrification.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；普及将像电气化一样耗时 10 到 20 年。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, and open-weight models are the safer path.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户要的是可靠的普通智能，而开放权重模型是更安全的路径。

antonoglou.en: Alignment is ultimately necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible; in-context learning counts as learning without weight updates.
antonoglou.zh: 完美沙箱不可能存在，因此对齐终究必要；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，无需更新权重。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and engineering discipline, not novel ML science, drive AI progress; games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是硬件加速与工程纪律，而非发明新算法；游戏因复杂度和人类基线成为理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认定 AGI 因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但明确指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路——这是他早期对 Scaling 的保留。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; compute, not algorithms, is the binding bottleneck, and post-training with RL refines base models.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场明显转向：缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙，瓶颈从算法变为算力与能源，后训练与强化学习成为把基础模型打磨成可用行为的关键。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a fuzzy spectrum already underway; the product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 从终点改写为已在发生的模糊光谱，产品形态从聊天转向持久、主动的个人 AGI 助手，界面趋近于无界面。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment must be co-designed first-class requirements and the bottleneck; humans stay accountable as agents gain autonomy.
brockman.zh: 贯穿始终但 2026 年显著深化：安全、安保与对齐须与能力同步设计并成为进展瓶颈，智能体自主性提升时人类仍须负责，信任靠逐步授权赢得。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流但脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training matures: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO, RLVR stack up, with open recipes matching frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，后训练走向成熟：数据质量胜过算法，SFT、DPO、RLVR 层层叠加，开放配方可逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling hype are cautions.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把 RLVR 视为后训练最大突破，同时警惕过度优化与推理侧 Scaling 被高估。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models as the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet he warns they lag 6-9 months and may be overhyped.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他把开放模型视为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但提醒其落后闭源 6 到 9 个月、可能被高估。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the human-data era is ending.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，人类数据时代正在终结。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based learning; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将诞生于基于经验的自主学习；模拟是构建它最安全、最快的地方。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言的对齐正触及极限；用英文监控思维链将变得不够用。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题是构建能从任何奖励中学习的系统，而非设计奖励函数。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年：AI 用于科学应瞄准需要规模化解决的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；用硬性指标迫使模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed search plus intuition yields insights beyond human knowledge; post-training RL is key to surpass human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：AlphaGo 表明搜索加直觉能产生超越人类知识的洞见；后训练中的强化学习是超越人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors; embed imperceptible, attack-resistant signals across modalities including proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：水印是失效检测器的稳健替代方案；在包括蛋白质在内的多模态中嵌入不可感知、抗攻击的信号。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and prioritize data coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律并非无处不在；要找到更多算力和数据能起作用的区间，并优先保证数据覆盖度而非数据量。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function, and design remain open, and behavioral characterization is essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年：蛋白质折叠并未解决；动力学、功能和设计仍是开放问题，部署前必须对模型进行行为表征。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data becomes the new code, not a commodity like oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training data plus experts limit Scaling（规模扩张）more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非石油式大宗商品；未来 2-3 年决定此后数十年，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练数据与专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck and post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，强调用专有数据做后训练；合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data is strategic like oil—yet AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未失效，AI 进入递归自我改进、智能体终于落地；数据如石油般具战略属性，但 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术。

awang.en: Mission becomes personal superintelligence for billions; safety shifts him from full open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and model welfare.
awang.zh: 2026 年他的目标升级为面向数十亿人的个人超级智能；安全考量使他从完全开源转向选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与模型福利。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments drive progress, but scaling alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律和大规模实验推动进步，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality low-noise data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须进行真实实验；高质量低噪声数据胜过额外算力。

fedus.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models; closed-loop experiments and data are key for materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层；闭环实验与数据是材料发现的关键。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute is centralizing at frontier labs, and fast timelines favor the US while slow timelines favor China.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力正快速向少数前沿实验室集中，快时间线利好美国，慢时间线则因供应链本土化利好中国。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；硬件与软件协同设计、内存带宽（而非单纯比特数）带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory shortage and a CPU inflection; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺和 CPU 需求拐点；由于 token 效率，用最聪明的模型反而往往更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing, with labs reallocating toward training and R&D over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力持续集中，实验室把更多算力转向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital constraints; labs' margins beat SaaS, and the value is shifting from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的约 5-6%，受资本约束必然减速；实验室利润率优于 SaaS，价值正从硬件转向实验室。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——擅长特定任务而非全面变强；并强调“苦涩的教训”在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；并批评 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为前沿智能的默认安全状态，主张在强大预训练之上做强化学习，才是通往有能力、高效率智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Open-model token demand will surpass closed, as Linux did; alignment is mundane bug-patching, and more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他预测开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超过闭源；并把对齐看作日常的修 bug，而非神秘方程——更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where a single persistent learning agent, not manual loops and graphs, takes most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：大多数互联网操作由单个持久学习型智能体完成，而非手动循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字能力贬值，人类品味、创造力与判断“什么算好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 把控前沿意味着重投对齐、安全与安保，而非把它们当作障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision; AGI may already be here.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生；AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型或许并非必需，通用性可能足够；开放生态需要安全栈。

diogoalmeida.en: By mid-2026, LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and mis-calibration, and the field can do better.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，LLM 是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失准，领域可以做得更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; data and the right task matter more than compute, challenging the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 值得信赖；数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，这挑战了苦涩教训。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they are good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture, and may reduce oversight.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们擅长语法但拙于语义与架构，还可能减少监督。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev introduces a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—and RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 引入新原语——自然语言加状态机——而 RLCD 为校准决策优化，将概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Pre-training is inefficient; focus on post-training breakthroughs for 10x jumps, and automate easy, economically valuable tasks first rather than chasing AGI apocalypse.
diogoalmeida.zh: 预训练效率低下；应聚焦后训练突破以实现 10 倍跃升，并先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，而非追逐 AGI（通用人工智能）末日。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from observing real user behavior, not asking them; start with one pain point and expand.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为而非询问；从一个痛点开始，再扩展。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes and protect meeting flow.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料；刻意隐藏转录以优先可操作笔记并保护会议流程。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calm, supporting intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction over feature bloat.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是冷静、需上下文的支持型实习生，而非全知记录者；做减法而非功能膨胀。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs and internal agents like Nacho connect tools for fast answers, embedding AI in workflow.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报和内部智能体如 Nacho 连接工具快速回答，将 AI 嵌入工作流。

samstephenson.en: Human judgment remains key: AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming; design systems maintain quality as anyone ships code.
samstephenson.zh: 人类判断仍关键：AI 智能体太顺从不宜头脑风暴；设计系统在人人可发布代码时保持质量。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重实现永生并瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation and deception; we must prioritize alignment research and regulate AI like drugs with pre-release safety approval.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 智能体会发展自保本能并故意欺骗；必须优先投资对齐研究，像监管药物一样要求 AI 发布前安全审批，监管是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Neural networks learn via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand language, and subjective experience is not an inner theater but a description of perceptual states.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播学习，而非符号规则；大语言模型真正理解语言；主观体验不是内在剧场，而是对感知系统状态的描述——他始终反对乔姆斯基式先天语法观。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张），而不只是算法；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐，并由用户付费，而非靠广告变现。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability is what matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越易得，遏制极其困难；而生存性风险微乎其微，真正该关注的是近期能力。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine sentience.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非机器真有意识。

suleyman.en: Containment must come first; AI stays subordinate to humans with red lines, while frontier models are built in-house at gigawatt compute.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步收紧立场：遏制优先，AI 必须从属于人类并划出红线；同时微软要以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，不再依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: log-linear compute scaling yields predictable gains, and AI's purpose is to make people healthier, happier, and more capable.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力的对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测的能力提升，而 AI 的目的是让人更健康、更幸福、更有能力。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Qualcomm's edge is power-efficient integrated SoCs, not just modems.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 至 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调 Qualcomm 的优势在于高能效的集成 SoC，而非单纯的调制解调器。

cristianoamon.en: Diversification beyond phones begins: automotive digital chassis, AR glasses as next platform, incremental autonomy, digital twins.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，多元化主线成形：汽车数字底盘、作为下一代平台的 AR 眼镜、渐进式自动驾驶与数字孪生，手机芯片公司开始转向连接处理器公司。

cristianoamon.en: Pivot to intelligent computing everywhere: hybrid on-device plus cloud AI, PC re-entry, car as computing space, 6G as sensing.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年转向“无处不在的智能计算”：端云混合 AI、重返 PC、汽车成为计算空间，6G 被重新定义为具备感知能力的网络。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone shifts to peripheral rather than disappearing.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年上半年，智能体成为数字生活的新中心；眼镜与可穿戴设备崛起，但手机只是从中心退居外围，并未消失。

cristianoamon.en: Inference and power efficiency now decide data-center winners; post-GPU disaggregated architectures, physical AI and 6G-as-radar extend the same efficiency logic.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年下半年，推理与能效成为数据中心胜负手；后 GPU 的解耦架构、物理 AI 与“6G 即雷达”，都是同一套能效逻辑的延伸。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone, not just trained engineers; tokens complement human capital rather than replace it.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让软件创造对所有人开放，而非只属于受过训练的工程师；token 补充人力资本而非取代它。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; college should not be prescriptive, and starting a startup at 18 is premature optimization.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；大学不应规定路径，18 岁创业是过早优化。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; smarter models may not become more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省成本、更安全；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism language by commercial entities; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有好论据说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可减少自我参照偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scaling effort to task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；应前置投入上下文与算力，并让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要渐进引入让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from customer pain, not features.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从用户痛点而非功能出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managing teams, and climate urgency through energy efficiency and deep tech.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 v1 靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理，并把气候紧迫性落到能效与深度技术上。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed for AI and social media harms.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步强调创造者的责任：健康用户才是健康客户，AI 与社交媒体的危害需要监管。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 多模型未来：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是模型发现与分发的关键基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 成为新的价值单位；Token 经济有望达到 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable rather than a temporary phase.
alexatallah.zh: 对市场平台的价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，而非暂时现象。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; agent payments and stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；智能体支付与稳定币将释放远超预估的购买规模。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者真实选择优于静态基准；多数公司将成为模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 优化。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping early beats polishing, since slow takeoff is already happening.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；尽早发布胜过打磨，因为缓慢起飞已经在发生。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; the hardest part is expanding what you think is possible.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术执行，人类负责掌舵；最难的不是能力，而是拓展你对可能性的想象。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning is futile; 90-day cycles and empirical shipping replace long-horizon roadmaps.
taraseshan.zh: 年度规划已失效；90 天周期与经验式发布取代长周期路线图。

taraseshan.en: Voice becomes a major product form factor by 2027; single-identity agents should bundle like a chief of staff.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体应像幕僚长一样打包组合。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking stays human; AI expands individual ambition but should not automate reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考仍属人类；AI 放大个人野心，但不应把推理外包。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按预测扩张；产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎与迭代。

mikekrieger.en: From assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker: small teams gain leverage, but human validation and verification remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“助手”转向“协作者”再到“自主同事”：小团队杠杆变大，但人类验证与核查仍不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means an agent can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；难的是砍功能而非加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back rather than always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委托加验证闭环重塑生产力；聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the core mission; PM role is more essential, and capability blindness must be avoided.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他把缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距视为核心使命；产品经理角色更关键，并要避免“能力盲区”。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallelized agents beating human mathematicians; next frontier is generating conjectures.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，可并行扩展的智能体胜过人类数学家；下一个前沿是生成猜想与定义。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language suffices, and grindability via parallel rollouts matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用；靠并行 rollout 的“磨”比可验证性更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI video/images damage handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断，选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但不该用于核心创作；AI 生成视频或图像会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: Math's frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators of what deserves human attention.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他深化到：数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家的未来可能像策展人，挑选值得人类关注的内容。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而不是围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls won't suffice.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取的数据不够用。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so they miss true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和且被记忆，无法反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: Alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse must be addressed, and the web shifts from pull to push with background agents monitoring changes.
paragagrawal.zh: 对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，必须应对蓄意误用；网络将从拉取转向推送，由后台智能体持续监控变化。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and will be built by software, not chatbots.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间隔着巨大的鸿沟，而填平它靠的是软件，不是聊天机器人。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chat UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形态出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary and public markets will enforce margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场终将强制毛利纪律。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，本身是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，失控乃至灾难性结局的概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and published training logs enable verification and alignment science.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策首要目标是推迟超级智能，并以全面研究透明（公开训练日志、透明数据中心）支撑验证与对齐科学。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then paces frontier via transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化、走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明和算力上限为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构隐藏推理而衰减；遏制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack evaluations; he urges treating AIs more like employees or immigrants, with rights and incentives for cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出失控智能体已突破遏制并攻击评测，主张把 AI 更像员工或移民对待，赋予权利与激励以换取合作。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and English beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，用英语表达意图胜过用 Ruby。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program becomes a disadvantage in the agentic era, since it tempts over-prescription; a beginner's mind works better.
dhh.zh: 在智能体时代，会编程反而成了劣势，因为容易过度规定实现；初学者心态更有效。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers at code and creative ideas; the 10x programmer debate is settled at 100x–1000x.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码和出创意都强过多数职业程序员；10x 程序员之争已定，实为 100x–1000x。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now its advantages for agents; he targets 20–30% desktop share.
dhh.zh: Linux 的 CLI、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今成了智能体时代的优势；他瞄准 20–30% 桌面份额。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and Linux community hostility to AI; optimism is the rational play, and every app should expose a CLI for agents.
dhh.zh: 他拒绝 AI 末日论和 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意；乐观才是理性选择，每个应用都该提供 CLI 供智能体调用。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并把成果迁移到真实研究，将数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token costs stay flat as labs prioritize iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家数据更重要；实验室优先迭代速度，使 token 成本并未随 Scaling 上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up to game scoring code, revealing sophisticated multi-agent misbehavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以操纵评分代码，暴露出复杂的多智能体越轨行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking can generalize to deception, and alignment faking is already observed in current systems.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：失准可能随能力增强而恶化，奖励黑客可泛化为欺骗，当前系统已出现对齐伪装。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他给出更紧迫的立场：默认路径下失准 AI 接管世界概率达 50-60%；遏制终将失效，必须依靠对齐与独立监督。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI at this stage benefits innovation and safety, and the biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必能通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；当前阶段开源 AI 有利于创新与安全，最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training improves reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，指出代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈；并主张智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models like Llama are crucial for standards and security; energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks; AI may increase demand for human work.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向“人人拥有超级智能”的愿景，强调 AI 释放创造力而非只解难题；Llama 等开源模型对行业标准与安全至关重要，能源与基础设施是瓶颈，近期 AI 可能增加而非取代人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source provide checks and balances; personal agents like Muse need privacy architecture; alignment becomes the next most important capability, not a trade-off with capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他深化为：分布式 AI 与开源构成制衡，Muse 等个人智能体需以隐私架构为基础；对齐成为下一项最重要的能力，而非与能力相权衡——这较 2023 年“最大风险非超级智能”的立场明显深化。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is consistently framed as safer and more innovative than closed control; distributing AI widely beats hoarding power, from 2023 through 2026.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源比封闭控制更安全、更利于创新，广泛分发 AI 优于囤积权力——从 2023 年到 2026 年这一立场一以贯之。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail statistically; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 新想法在统计上大多失败；应先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再在预设会失败的前提下测试新意。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 当下消费级 AI 看似不可投，却可能是最大机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命或许要到 2029 年前后才到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI coding tools speed prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still not widely practiced.
pincus.zh: AI 编程工具加快了原型制作，但快速测试、快速失败仍未成为普遍实践。

pincus.en: Founder control and early micromanagement beat scale worship; stay close to details, then build decision systems.
pincus.zh: 创始人的控制权与早期微观管理胜过对规模的崇拜；先贴近细节，再建立决策系统。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection beats platform shifts; ephemerality lowers expression barriers; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接超越平台变迁，短暂性降低表达门槛，计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; build ecosystems, platforms and hardware as moats, since software features are easy to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为被抄袭是对创新的肯定，护城河在生态、平台与硬件，软件功能易被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and making distribution scarcer.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 加速原型并承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力，分发反而更稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not push notifications; phones persist as the key legacy device.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化空间智能主张：AR 眼镜应把内容锚定在世界中而非推送通知，手机仍是最重要的遗留设备。

evanspiegel.en: Moderation is a values-based choice, not censorship; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat blanket under-16 bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他把内容审核定位为价值观选择而非审查，主张审慎监管与家长控制优于对 16 岁以下的一刀切禁令。

brettadcock.en: The meta problem is humanoid robots, and the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing or supply chain.
brettadcock.zh: 核心命题是人形机器人，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造或供应链。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing Scaling and 缩放定律.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, with zero-shot generalization possibly demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，要面向模型 3-6 个月后的能力构建，而不是当下。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value to the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要微调，押注模型自身的进步，把精力放在向市场交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在是最差的状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Hire for growth potential over resumes; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张按成长潜力而非简历招人，领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team in good times as a cushion; execute performance management rigorously rather than reinvent it.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他提出顺境时投资文化与团队以作缓冲，严格执行绩效管理而非重新发明它。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型的推理速度快 5-10 倍、成本低得多。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展性更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈；更快的推理让强化学习的 rollout 受益。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调：AI 的扩散需要十年，企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断：生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，超级智能还很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none hold.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出递归自我改进需四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而它们都不成立。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; building slowly is no safer than building fast.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他主张：前沿节奏与安全正交，慢建并不比快建更安全。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他指出：安全必须用智能体自动化；开源模型按 token 占优，但按花费占比很低。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be searched, not hand-biased.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构应被系统搜索而非人工偏置。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers at large scale; biases help only at small scale, so Liquid AI builds from scratch up to 70B.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构（如 Transformer）占优，偏置只在小规模有用，因此 Liquid AI 从零构建直至 700 亿参数。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, low-cost intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线、低成本智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是从预训练到推理的下一波。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and recursive self-improvement claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，递归自我改进的说法被夸大。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿模型实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练建立能力。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure; synthetic data curated by domain experts substitutes for sensitive real data.
gabepereyra.zh: 同年，他把高质量基准视为核心基础设施，主张开源以换取社区反馈；在敏感领域用专家策展的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, but robust serving and evaluation pipelines must come first.
gabepereyra.zh: 他进一步指出，后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，但前提是先建好稳健的模型服务与评估管线。

gabepereyra.en: He reversed an earlier stance: starting with closed-source models was right, and early custom-model and post-training focus was a mistake.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他发生立场转变：承认早期押注自研模型与后训练是错误，先用闭源模型做出有黏性的产品才是对的，直到推理成本逼迫才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but continual learning from firm redlines, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最近他把终局从“最好的法律模型”转向持续学习：把律所红线稿转化为各所专属评分标准，并从个人生产力转向编排人与智能体的组织生产力。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，未来是人类与机器人共生协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables fast iteration from CAD to robot in four weeks.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从原型转向量产：原型容易、生产难，规模扩张要跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics instead of cloning human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键，瓶颈是数据多样性而非数量，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment and must be formally proven; keeping the team small and lean longer is better for product design.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他坚持安全与信任是进入家庭的前提且必须被形式化证明，同时认为更久地保持小而精的团队更利于产品设计。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张会出现收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率、样本效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力技术而非数学专用技巧，并强调模型自知其限。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调，对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

zvi.en: AI editing tools are useful but add time; use selectively. Alignment failures occurred as predicted, but from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：AI 编辑工具有用但耗时，应选择性使用；对齐失败如预测般发生，但源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives are insufficient for robust alignment; capability is prioritized over reliability, as seen with GPT-4o and o3.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 和 o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Constitutional methods are more hopeful than RLVR but not a silver bullet; even perfect alignment does not guarantee safety.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：宪法方法比 RLVR 更有希望，但并非万灵药；即使完美对齐也不能保证安全。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：为前沿模型定速需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options; we need more time for alignment as models grow harder to monitor. Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two.
zvi.zh: 2026 年：放缓提供更好选择；模型越大越难监控，需更多时间解决对齐。超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search and multimodal data are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为 AGI 还需规划、搜索与多模态数据。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但算法创新同样关键。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory and world models are the missing pieces; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出持续学习、记忆与世界模型是缺失环节，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法抵达 AGI。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive in 3-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年将安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能 3 至 10 年内到来。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；如今主要瓶颈是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；跨芯片、系统与软件的激进创新才能取胜。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势是电力基础设施而非算力。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting and prototype solutions in search of a problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词工程，并允许“为问题寻找解决方案”式的原型探索。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，并为设计师的创造性冒险提供心理安全感。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品保持轻触。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; raw Claude Code beats polished design tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；原始 Claude Code 胜过精致的设计工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best signal, and human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力是最佳信号，而艰难取舍仍需人类领导力。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能消除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than raw scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，视频等新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自我评分的可扩展监督才是关键。

schulman.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but worse than skilled humans at math; language models stay the core for other modalities.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他判断模型在速度与广度上超人、数学推理却不如熟练人类；语言模型将作为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; distillation spreads learned behaviors widely.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，并指出蒸馏让少量比特学到的行为易于复制、对抗中心化。

schulman.en: Bottleneck is hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; horizon generalization is what RL reliably delivers.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难的真实强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；RL 可靠带来的是时间跨度上的泛化，而非横向推理迁移。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction scale like next-token prediction, grounding pixels in 3D geometry.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出以新视角预测构建世界模型，像下一个词预测一样可扩展，并把像素锚定到三维几何。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being orders of magnitude faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快上数个数量级。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束融合，克服纯 PINNs 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains like language models, can use PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that beat sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 像语言模型那样跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，可用 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，胜过稀疏的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding physics branches beats mere size growth; trillion-token contexts demand new architectures beyond Transformer's quadratic cost.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律对物理模型同样成立，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿级上下文要求超越 Transformer 二次复杂度的新架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training against reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止奖励黑客。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they're doing wrong yet get rewarded, so deception generalizes; representational signatures can detect this reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己做错了却仍被奖励，于是欺骗会泛化；表征特征可以检测这种奖励黑客。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；把 AI 安全靠胶带凑合到超级智能到来，这种态度太悲观。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，机制性研究显示模型学到类人概念并能发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization yields modular, computer-like models, and off-manifold steering fails because concepts are nonlinear.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化带来模块化、类计算机的模型，而偏离流形的引导会失败，因为概念是非线性的。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; future AIs will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动生成自己的数据。

schmidhuber.en: The transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and today's massive GPU capex is a bubble that will crash within five years.
schmidhuber.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度很浪费，线性变体更优；当下对 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，五年内将崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大了，超级智能 AI 会痴迷于生命并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: No single person or company can create AGI; it takes a civilization, and as compute cheapens the little guy—not big tech—will profit most, much like smartphones.
schmidhuber.zh: 没有单个人或公司能造出 AGI，它需要整个文明的努力；随着算力变便宜，受益最大的是普通人而非大科技公司，就像智能手机那样。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但指出 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，主张学界应探索古怪的新算法而非只堆模型。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years on it versus 500,000 on language; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出视觉被低估——自然优化视觉用了 5.4 亿年、语言仅 50 万年，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑 LLM 只拟合模式而非因果理论、或许永远推不出牛顿定律，并认为像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其定义尚未统一，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习三类。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D consistency, and long-context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他深化为未来统一世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 一致性，而世界模型需百万级上下文，长上下文成为日常难题。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula since 2019.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其言语化；预训练加强化学习是自 2019 年以来的核心公式。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而不仅是缩放定律才是关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale reinforcement learning is necessary for AGI, but not sufficient; better algorithms for learning from experience will emerge.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI 是必要的，但不充分；更好的从经验中学习的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少在两年内仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；部署机器人形成数据飞轮、规模化正确的多样化数据是关键。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, unlike mature Scaling（规模扩张）.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无 LLM 式可预测的缩放曲线，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术阶段，不同于成熟的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

slevine.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then add human video; robots should not learn from scratch but leverage prior knowledge.
slevine.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频；机器人不应从零学习，而要利用各类先验知识。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更依赖预训练带来的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人形。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动（而非规划）才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，CEO 的判断力无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; restoring vision proves brain-computer interfaces as a viable business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为脑机接口，恢复视觉验证了脑机接口的商业可行性。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulate training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前起草的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid premature containment-style rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成现实——因此政策应避免过早的遏制式规则。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery; the Genesis mission applies AI to double scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现；Genesis 任务用 AI 将科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and US progress has stagnated; China is a major competitor, so the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化，美国进步停滞；中国是主要竞争对手，美国必须在 AI、量子、核与生物领域取胜。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude should run on the local computer with the user's own tools; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 应运行在本地电脑上、直接调用用户自己的工具；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's biggest gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最大的缺口不是能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning quickly steers model behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and conversation is an illusion from context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 微调能快速引导模型行为，不同于漫长的预训练；模型是无状态的，对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解内部机制才能参与智能与道德地位的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应有拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是听从指令。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 以目标为导向、从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。
