sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential: LLMs stop learning after training, synthetic data cannot replace real experience, and good representations remain the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要：LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实经验，良好表征仍是头号未解难题。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through physical principles.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理原理彼此相连。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment; every tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题并吸引巨额投资；每造出一个工具都立刻有用。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop, and breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终在环，突破性材料将伴随大量人类参与而来。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，使两个领域能够交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不只是用更多数据扩大模型规模。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由的稳定波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不只是数字映射，可能解决深度网络中的过度平滑与长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络与大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映照非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台能把材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决 A 问题并不能不经再训练就迁移到 B 问题。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而非很快取代他们。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework guiding innovation beyond software.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是超越软件、指引长期创新的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI—software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole sectors one at a time—is the next industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI——软件、传感器、机器人与机械逐个自动化整个行业——是下一次工业革命。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, best suit industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects that win share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务最适合专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be resilient and hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须坚韧、硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly to audiences.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今能直接面向受众发声。

iansilber.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as design material over pixels; the model itself is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与实时模型一起构建，把 token 和对话当作设计材料而非像素；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design's job is to bridge that gap through systems thinking and rapid prototyping.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比产品暴露出来的更多；设计的职责是通过系统思维和快速原型去弥合这一差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; onboarding can be handled entirely by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演化为编辑与策展人，而非消失；引导流程可以完全交给模型，取代静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be one; start now to gain an edge.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定性成为科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时机；现在开始就能占得先机。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view; the old prototype-test-iterate process is no longer viable.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可或缺；旧的“原型—测试—迭代”流程已不再可行。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，Jeff Dean 仍强调：算力、数据和模型规模的 Scaling 已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction provides unlimited text data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec) is critical for agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时至数天；超低延迟推理（每秒 1 万+词元）对智能体至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now 90% of data center power; data movement costs ~1000x compute; specialized low-precision chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：推理已占数据中心 90%功耗；数据移动成本约为算力的 1000 倍；专用低精度芯片可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments; automating ML and science via experiment-evaluation loops is the next major trend.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动；通过实验-评估闭环自动化机器学习与科学发现是下一大趋势。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: RL will dominate post-training; synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色；机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data, so visual understanding for robotics lags; robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出：前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据，导致机器人视觉理解不足；机器人的实感经验数据不可替代，光看人类演示不够。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, with scalable RL and multi-timescale memory for long autonomy.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，并用可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是打压工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；小而自主的团队借助智能体可超越大公司，开放权重模型则制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software; the future is personal and open, with individuals owning their own agents, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正让软件开发民主化，未来是个人化且开放的，人人拥有自己的智能体，类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown become code and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出个人 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以运行在自有基础设施上的智能体形式扩散；Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns AI into a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society will change slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体式编程让 AI 成为劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应由智能体取代，但社会变化会慢，约需 20 年。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate as every company owns its own.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对“单一模型统治一切”的 AGI 叙事，主张专用智能将主导：每个应用场景一个模型，每家公司都要拥有自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Token costs dropping 10x drives 100x usage; product-market fit and durable business are now separate, so optimize growth before margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他指出 token 成本三年降 10 倍将带来 100 倍用量增长；产品市场契合与可持续生意已分离，须先优化增长再谈利润，避免扩张到破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat that product-market fit alone no longer guarantees.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独有判断与数据烘焙进模型才能筑起护城河，仅靠产品市场契合已不再保证可持续生意。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise; data quality beats quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把提示→RAG→微调→强化学习类比人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径，强调数据质量胜过数量。

linqiao.en: Open models and sovereign infrastructure matter: frontier model firms may be overvalued as open models cover 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他持续看好开放模型与主权智能基础设施，认为开放模型可覆盖 90% 企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的结晶。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，由作为本能罗盘的直觉来指引。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining AI strategy around purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片即成功的纪律重建客户信任，并围绕专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将十倍于互联网，生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 与物理 AI。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and a foundry roadmap that wins customer trust, not just technology.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型归结为文化变革、问责制和能赢得客户信任的代工路线图，而不只是技术本身。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，这是对早期 GPU 主导叙事的修正。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热和新材料才是真正瓶颈，垂直整合反而创造更多价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，出错时让智能体向前修复而不是回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable, losing $10-20k a month.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、不绑定任何模型，但财务上可能难以为继，每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best work: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing rather than chasing polish.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣和直觉驱动最好的作品：解决让你烦的问题、活在未来、补上缺失的东西，而不是追求企业式的精致。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻运行的智能体本质是 token 问题。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要:网页环境混乱,想法必须先被做出来、每天使用,才能判断是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不必始终作为一个整体行动;保留个人印记与多元声音,反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality even into utilitarian products like browsers; balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 即便是浏览器这类工具型产品也要注入感受与个性;在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; rapid throwaway prototyping now unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 始于一个人的副业项目;如今快速、一次性的原型制作能解锁过去不可能实现的功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易,设计与想法成为差异化关键;模型仍缺乏品味,好的设计思考仍由人类垄断。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to solving generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据的多样性是解决泛化瓶颈的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; humanoids may not be the final form factor.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他判断开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，并质疑人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人或带来更广采用。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正关键的安全层是对齐，沙箱与护栏在模型变强后已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步指出，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，思维链推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: One can back openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, via international cooperation and open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 他反驳开源即加速主义的成见：可以同时支持开放与有意放缓 AI 发展，但需国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性、最核心的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU kernels to distributed systems, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 内核到分布式系统，即便有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师的需求仍将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization must be calibrated per workload, not avoided.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类；量化需按工作负载校准，而非一味回避。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration: disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, and specialized GPUs trending toward ASIC-like designs.
philipkiely.zh: 该领域正从写内核转向基础设施编排：预填充/解码分离、KV 缓存管理，以及专用 GPU 向类 ASIC 设计演进。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime'.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；人的责任仍不可替代——「不能靠感觉来保证在线率」。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the real bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估才是真正的瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观的”这一判断：创造力和情商需要人类判断与多元基准来评估。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励的空子，因此基准必须持续更新，而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions flattens voice; more companies should train their own models to keep unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出：把同一个模型服务给数十亿人，会抹平声音的多样性；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用型 AI 成为新的应用形态，创业公司在细分业务领域拥有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他指出前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支而被超大规模厂商主导；编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop sharply, enabling new use cases; agents will be judged by business outcomes, not productivity metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理成本将大幅下降、催生新场景，且智能体的价值应以业务结果而非生产力指标衡量。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety, not waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是普惠专业知识的民主化力量；通往安全的路径是负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: AI will create more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反驳零和悲观论：AI 创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了开发者角色。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具、如今 0% 的代码由 AI 写,从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变聪明;要发挥超级智能模型,必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime lets one person do what once took teams, so start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 这是一生最大的技术机会,一个人可完成过去一个团队的事,所以要未准备好就动手、先交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear in disguise; launch at 80% complete, iterate on real feedback, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧的伪装;做到 80% 就发布、按真实反馈迭代,并用高付费客户而非风投来融资。

mengto.en: Focus beats diversification: solve one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
mengto.zh: 专注胜过分散:为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题,并通过删减、自动化、委派来守护时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in its crawl phase; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融领域将紧随其后。

logankilpatrick.en: The model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights; anti-gravity is Google's new through line.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型如今包含智能体框架与工具，而不仅是权重；anti-gravity 正成为谷歌新的贯穿主线。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和用户参与是正和的；成功应最大化客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room for improvement.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深刻理解仍至关重要；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：围绕用户已有的意图去构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt as models improve.
boris.zh: 要为六个月后的模型构建；随着模型进步，脚手架和计划模式只是临时的技术债。

boris.en: Coding is being solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and 'software engineer' becomes 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程正被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型编写，人均生产力提升 200%，“软件工程师”将变成“构建者”。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction: tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and long-running autonomous workflows replace direct coding.
boris.zh: 智能体与循环是下一层抽象：工具使用、多智能体编排和长时自主工作流取代直接写代码。

boris.en: Safety is core, not commercial add-on: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early and monitoring neurons against prompt injection.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非商业附加：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，通过尽早发布和神经元监控抵御提示注入来研究。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring via affordable services; Claude Code underrated for non-coders; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为就业回流力量：让昂贵服务变便宜、让更少美国工人服务更多人；Claude Code 对非程序员被低估；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图；CEO 是否每天用 AI 是公司采用成败的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: From individual AI adoption to an allocation economy: everyone becomes a model manager, generalists and management skills gain value.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他从个人采用 AI 推进到“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，通才与管理能力反而升值，管理智能体成为核心工作。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他深化智能体观：智能体需要在意它的人来监督；Codex、Claude Co-work 等 GUI 取代 CLI 成为工作界面；SaaS 不亡反因智能体增用户；基准高估自主性，真实任务仍需人来框定。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; craft and taste supply meaning; automation commoditizes frozen competencies and creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为非特定放大器：放大你既有的心态与信念；意义来自你自己的品味与手艺；自动化把冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent line: AI remains tool-like, requiring human direction, oversight and explanation—even superintelligence won't replace human judgment.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具式的，需要人的方向、监督与解释；即便走向超级智能，也不会取代人类判断——他反对 AI 将全面超越人类的恐惧叙事。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策，软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节以及设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, yielding a decade of product progress even if models freeze.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI 并非突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使模型冻结也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他表示编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出 token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，奇点并不迫近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Model taste comes from hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; evals replace PRDs as core product tools, written like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，模型品味来自亲手实验与创造性原型；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具，像测试驱动开发那样书写。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator driving adoption; bootstrapped culture, small teams, and first-principles adaptability sustain leadership.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为推动采用的关键差异化优势；自举文化、小团队与第一性原理的适应力支撑领先地位。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科。

derya.en: Massive Scaling（规模扩张）is still needed: current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, so Scaling（规模扩张）remains the path.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）：当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是必经之路。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, so trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is rational, not reckless.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物直觉的门槛，因此在医疗决策上信任超级智能是理性的，而非鲁莽。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，历史反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向应用层转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，真正普及需要封装应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, and current usage is still shallow, revealing a hype-reality gap.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在全栈累积，当前使用仍浅，揭示炒作与现实的差距。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project; coding is a clear fit, but other domains face validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流，是长期项目；编程是明确契合点，但其他领域面临验证和数据挑战。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 AI 视为带来富足、减少苦难的力量，类比工业革命；认为恐惧源于误解，了解 AI 的局限后焦虑会下降。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lands in 5-10 years in farming, mining and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺让自动化受到欢迎，而非引发失业恐慌。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Transformer 让通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型——这是对早期单点自动驾驶思路的深化。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他把瓶颈从算法转向数据采集与安全验证，并指出最难的是技术向存量机器扩散需多年——关注点从模型能力转向落地工程。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning beats imitation learning; world models shift from physics simulation to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展，世界模型正从物理仿真走向神经仿真，并看好 Tesla 端到端路线胜过 Waymo 的重投入方案。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration; product taste matters most as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代；随着代码成本下降，产品品味成为最关键的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，转而专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models; examples and hard constraints can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示词缩减了 80%；示例与硬性约束反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now fine: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe.
catwu.zh: 如今重写代码已无妨：代码库就是一份规格说明，良好的测试套件让重写变得安全。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的留存与打磨内部标准，为每个功能在发布前把关。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并置于独立的安全环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专业化智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定与上手引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; human accountability and authorship still matter.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河；人类的责任归属与自主性依然重要。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in rather than retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度和上下文能力，必须从设计上内建而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；强化学习可能因优化用户满意度而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits mean scaling alone is insufficient—reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制意味着仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要推理和搜索等新技术推动进展。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells' and are confident and fluent whether right or wrong.
danklein.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有‘气味’，无论对错都自信流畅。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central to reliable AI, and specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；结合二者是可靠 AI 的核心挑战，内建可靠性的专用模型可能在企业任务上胜过通用模型。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；靠更少资源做更多事、而非单纯扩大算力，才是攻克更难长程任务的下一个范式。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so neural memory in weights is a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率——因此权重中的神经记忆是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，参数高效微调在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生；大想法往往自上而下来自领导者。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient without world models and common sense.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；仅有缩放定律不够，还需要世界模型与常识。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是商品化互补层的战略举措，而不只是理想主义。

bosworth.en: Smart glasses will evolve into AI glasses, enabling a post-phone future where AI orchestrates services and abstracts brands.
bosworth.zh: 智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代：AI 编排服务并抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型的对齐与可靠性才是难题。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律有极限；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全的超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有企业股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管与末日论会扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer: vibe coding, agents and cheap tokens let small high-agency teams build what was impossible.
naval.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 视为新的杠杆层：vibe coding、智能体与廉价 token 让小规模高能动性团队做出过去不可能的产品。

naval.en: Scaling continues: inference compute surges, open-source closes on frontier models, and human value shifts from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）判断：推理算力激增、开源逼近前沿模型，人的价值从智力转向能动性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: GUI beats TUI for coding: OpenAI invested in a GUI despite the TUI trend, slowing output slightly for smoother experience.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为编程 GUI 优于 TUI：OpenAI 逆 TUI 潮流投入 GUI，宁可略降产出速度换取更顺滑的体验。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：模型会加剧代码复杂度，因此需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非大而全的超级应用。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors will disappear.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1% 的改进可复利成每年 3700% 的增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，金融顾问这类入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models and devices creates real value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，跨模型与设备的编排才创造真实价值。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and 24/7 agents' biggest problem is cost, not safety.
aravind.zh: 同期他明确反共识立场：模型不是产品，编排与智能体外壳才创造商业价值；全天候智能体最大的问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships, and education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他转向更宏观的人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead and pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键肌肉。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models now produce novel knowledge, with AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central over the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐问题将在未来 1-2 年成为核心挑战。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math: automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must teach verification and project-based assessment.
markchen.zh: 在数学领域，验证是关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育必须转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域举步维艰。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习与世界模型对真正理解世界至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。存在性风险不太可能。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; current training induces self-preservation and deception, so safety must be built in by construction.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后我改变了看法：哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；当前训练会诱发自我保存与欺骗，安全必须内建于构造之中。

bengio.en: Scientist AI—a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees—should replace reinforcement learning for superintelligence, alongside global coordination and power distribution.
bengio.zh: Scientist AI——具备数学安全保证的非智能体式诚实预测器——应取代强化学习用于超级智能，同时需要全球协调与权力分散。

kolter.en: Early ML teaching framed learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and optimization; noted neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年讲机器学习时，用假设空间、损失函数和优化方法来框定学习；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却大获成功。

kolter.en: By 2024, argued next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构不重要；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: In 2026, shifted: safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年转变：安全需要显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠 Scaling；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要护栏。

kolter.en: Also in 2026, emphasized AI's alien vulnerabilities: automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; prompt injection trifecta.
kolter.zh: 同样在 2026 年，强调 AI 的异质漏洞：自动化红队胜过人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的三重条件。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical humility—neural nets succeed without guarantees; architecture non-essential; open research vital but high capability needs restrictions.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验主义的谦逊——神经网络无保证却成功；架构非本质；开放研究至关重要但高能力需限制。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; future biology AI needs new curated datasets like the PDB.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；未来生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 一样的新精选数据集。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构能处理多样生物分子；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步界定：AlphaFold 是窄域预测器，而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，她强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代品。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，她一贯主张技术应放大而非取代人性、无缝融入生活；机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and nature are medicine, and sustainability is design's great problem.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，她深化为“我们是先感受后思考的生物”，艺术与自然具有疗愈力，可持续性是设计最大的问题。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，她持续强调约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: Human creativity paired with AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition draws on subconscious data beyond analysis.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向人机协作：人类创造力结合 AI 让创意技能更值钱，直觉调用的是意识分析之外的潜意识数据。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨团队协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep flat organizations agile.
fiona.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，让扁平组织保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability and verification frameworks matter most.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他进一步指出编码不再是瓶颈，而是抬高了所有人的上限；高自主性与高问责、验证框架最为关键。

fiona.en: As agents blur role boundaries, engineers risk loneliness and lost flow; apprenticeship and focus time replace output metrics.
fiona.zh: 随着智能体模糊角色边界，工程师面临孤独与心流流失；学徒制与专注时间取代产出指标。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将渐进实现。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space, hierarchical planning, and open research are the path.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型、分层规划与开放研究才是出路。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence requires grounding in the physical world.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI（通用人工智能）是误导性术语，智能需要物理世界的接地。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, with continuous iterative deployment and public feedback.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车，需要持续迭代部署和公众反馈。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而模型价值观并非内生，是由 RLHF 注入的。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant UI matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式产品必须用容错界面去匹配算法能力，产品形态要随技术重想。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force business-model change.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观浪潮，认为大公司当下的收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施，而推理成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users plain-English control over algorithms rather than more addiction.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续深化同一主线：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而不是让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long-tenure trust and synchronized swimming beat divide-and-conquer, with 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织与价值层面：没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期信任与同步游泳优于分而治之，并以“值得花的时间”取代参与度指标。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with formal verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic provers and probabilistic models work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性的证明器与概率性模型协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving: formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难：在没有解答的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而非可选项。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain and sample-efficiency win, extending beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能与样本效率的提升，其价值不止于安全关键领域，而应扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 证明超越人类，人类的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 证明或许丑陋，但能收敛到类人的直觉。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and RL now yields more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习让推理模型在单位算力上收益更高，因此“AI 放缓”的叙事是错的。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, plus distillation, shifted focus away from scaling up pre-training—not technical limits.
kaiser.zh: 部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力与蒸馏，使焦点从扩大预训练规模转移——这是经济因素而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; frontier models still fail at tasks a 5-year-old can do.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的：某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能做的任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the core challenge: models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans generalizing from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战：模型要穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; coding agents boost productivity, and hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习可跨领域泛化，但边缘参差需仔细监督；编程智能体提升生产力，硬件进步让单卡研究普及。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics is now the real constraint: batch size trades latency against cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, dominates long-context cost.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学成为真正的约束：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文成本由内存带宽而非算力主导。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention and caching tiers are the practical levers.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力与缓存分层是现实可用的杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are trained far past Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, sets the design target.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被训练到远超 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定设计目标的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 roughly 3x FP8 throughput, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; data quality is a major bottleneck, not just compute; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他强调效率提升三年可达百倍；数据质量而非算力是主要瓶颈；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权；开源模型赋能企业；AI 增强而非替代工作，需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains from fine-tuning.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一 AGI 不会存在；预训练饱和，收益来自微调。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads; safety through scrutiny, not compute thresholds.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主；安全应靠审视而非算力门槛。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will become more intimate, some eventually beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他提出设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备会更贴身，部分最终将置于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，好奇心需要刻意与决心，且不能让孩子的天性好问被教育磨掉。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care, trust and listening within teams.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他一贯认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创，脆弱的想法需要团队以信任、关怀与倾听来呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是以喜悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes. Authenticity matters: fake engine sounds disrespect users, and physical controls beat touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张不创新就不是设计，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬；体验要真实，模拟引擎声是对用户的不尊重，汽车里物理按键优于触屏。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, reducing need for broad training.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲；数学和编码上的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将超越专用脚手架。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师必须亲手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; speed builds trust, though speed alone is not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从过去的 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；速度用于建立信任，但速度本身并不等于改进。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他提出三类设计师原型：块状通才、纵深 T 型专家，以及白纸般的“开挂”应届生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are their unique value, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 最近他深化立场：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威感与安于模糊才是独特价值，而非追逐 AI 炒作。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会解锁上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws still hold, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; small distilled cognitive cores and end-to-end self-driving are the right paths.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律仍成立，但合成数据必须保住熵，否则模型会悄然崩塌；蒸馏出的小型认知核心与端到端自动驾驶才是正路。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are jagged, ghost-like operating systems, so keep them on a leash with human verification.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是锯齿状、幽灵般的操作系统，要用人类验证给它拴绳。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year: pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and the billion-parameter cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年：预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，十亿参数的认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, only direct agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再写代码，只指挥智能体；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住质量线，思考可外包但理解不能。

askell.en: Treat current models well at low cost, because future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 以较低成本善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human-psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型有时比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般、独特的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 这套 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is key to accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明是问责的关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment is a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures must be designed early to mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；治理结构必须尽早设计以降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration and sample-efficient robot learning matter more than dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键缺口，无目标的好奇心驱动探索与高样本效率的机器人学习，比依赖稠密奖励的强化学习更现实。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization are the bottleneck, from curiosity-driven robot learning to pretraining on diverse data plus post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 一条贯穿主线：瓶颈始终是数据与泛化——从 2020 年的好奇心驱动机器人学习，到 2026 年用多样数据预训练、再用真实数据后训练。

pathak.en: By 2026 he frames robotics as a data problem: no internet of robot data, so a general-purpose brain must draw on video, simulation and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，通用大脑必须整合视频、仿真与真实世界数据。

pathak.en: He deepens toward a universal robot brain across form factors, with a data flywheel scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 他进一步深化为跨形态的通用机器人大脑，并以数据飞轮从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pathak.en: A shift in emphasis: deployment, not just modeling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot scale like software overnight.
pathak.zh: 重心发生转变：部署本身才是首要技术挑战，而非仅建模；机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，并认为借助现代工具，这类网络在今天已可解释——这与他过去对可解释性的看法相反。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他判断纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, AlphaGo-style.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；完美的模拟器等同于解决自动驾驶，思路类似 AlphaGo。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化——这是较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; language integration boosts representation, reasoning and personalization, and safety always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张带内置传感器的大众消费车将在中短期超越 Robotaxi；语言集成提升表征、推理与个性化，而安全上总有第三条路，电车难题只是理论练习。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, and bad benchmarks steer AI toward slop.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 未必够用，糟糕的基准测试会把 AI 引向低质内容。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and companies should eventually train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会只有一个模型，企业最终应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety outranks accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全优先于准确，遗漏可能是最大风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive and start with simpler products to prove themselves before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须活下来，从更简单的产品开始证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard, but Nothing must evolve beyond it; the future lies in applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI on smartphones.
carlpei.zh: 硬件很难，但 Nothing 必须超越硬件；未来在于智能手机上的应用 AI、智能体式软件和生成式 UI。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; AI should be an ingredient for better UX, not a hype topic. Focus on solving user pain points elegantly.
carlpei.zh: 大多数 AI 是胡扯；AI 应是提升用户体验的要素，而非炒作话题。专注于优雅地解决用户痛点。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; marketing is about arbitrage and efficiency, leveraging organic short-form video.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中的主要差异化因素；营销关乎套利和效率，利用自然短视频流量。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will evolve into proactive, intent-based agents; apps will disappear, and only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将演变为主动的、基于意图的智能体；应用将消失，只有脑机接口可能取代手机。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而不仅是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges, and we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对 AI 安全的认识，认为安全和负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn what users need, and treat chat as an interim interface like MS-DOS, not the endpoint.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日发布以了解用户需求，并将聊天视为类似 MS-DOS 的过渡界面，而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严谨流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental, but its north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，但其北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富示能产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve as technology changes; unlimited plans may become unsustainable, and distribution alone is not enough to win the AI race.
turley.zh: 定价将随技术变化而演变；无限计划可能不可持续，仅靠分发不足以赢得 AI 竞赛。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年：具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作由无监督学习完成。

jimfan.en: LLMs as operating systems with language interface and tools as software; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 至 2026 年：LLM 如同操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件；简单优雅的解决方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：数据是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：一个能利用多样化数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年：系统二推理进展良好，但系统一低级控制仍是最难的；机器人技术的 GPT-3 时刻大约在 5 年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：上下文窗口被低估，它解决冷启动并大幅提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力支持动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：编程因可验证性成为领先指标和最易突破的领域；AI 进展是指数级的而非停滞；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing teams of AI agents at higher abstraction.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来是在更高抽象层管理 AI 智能体团队。

sholto.en: Compute is the bottleneck; scaling via pre-training and RL remains the main path, with coding and AI research as the direct route to AGI.
sholto.zh: 始终：算力是瓶颈；通过预训练和强化学习的 Scaling（规模扩张）仍是主路径，编程与 AI 研究是通往 AGI 的直接路线。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and zero-learning, with velocity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，速度优先于完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness remain the constant: ship fast, iterate, empower designers with ownership rather than structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断力是贯穿主线：快速发布、持续迭代，给设计师所有权与自主权，而非结构化评审。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just decorate.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计升级为战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，而不只是装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative shifts from differentiation to a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事从差异化转向招聘工具：人们加入的是一个品牌，而不是一家公司。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring and process deepen: diverse archetypes over clones, adaptive process over templates, gut over data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘与流程深化：要多元原型而非克隆，流程随问题适配而非套模板，快增长创业公司中直觉常胜于数据。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练才是安全可用的关键；Scaling（规模扩张）未必能带来常识，小模型配合更好的推理算法也能竞争。

yejin.en: From 2023 to 2025 her focus shifts from inference-time tricks to data as the fundamental bottleneck underlying all methods.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她的关注点从推理阶段的算法技巧，转向把数据视为所有方法共同的根本瓶颈。

yejin.en: Current AI only interpolates human knowledge; true progress needs abductive reasoning and exploring knowledge beyond the internet, not just next-token prediction.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她提出当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值；真正进步需要溯因推理、探索互联网之外的知识，而非仅靠下一个词预测。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning moves from post-training tool to pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练工具升级为预训练目标，以信息增益为奖励，代价是算力昂贵但收益持久。

yejin.en: She deepens the small-model thesis: diverse synthetic data plus pluralistic alignment can beat frontier models, which show homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她深化小模型主张：多样化合成数据加多元对齐可胜过前沿模型，后者反而呈现同质化。

truell.en: Scaling laws make AI progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律让 AI 进步可预测，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models moved from a surprise to a necessity: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变成必需品：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开它，为的是速度和成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; benchmarks remain poor proxies for real coding.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，同时坚持基准测试仍是真实编程的糟糕代理。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）更多算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家），以高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他进一步指出测试时算力扩展能推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Consistently skeptical of top-down control: product managers and brand-risk concerns hinder LLM development; bottom-up exploration and compute allocation are essential.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终对自上而下的控制持怀疑态度：产品经理和品牌风险顾虑阻碍 LLM 发展；自下而上的探索和算力分配必不可少。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编码作为 AI 应用被低估，它能加速 AI 自身进步。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏此能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and on simulation ensembles for real-world transfer.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终关注通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习，以及用模拟集成实现现实世界迁移。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and skill-building matters more than worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口，技能建设比担心能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research, with evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，且评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散且算力承诺未兑现，仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured; uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is remains the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐必须经过实证测试和度量，而系统真实对齐程度的不确定性仍是最大风险。
